from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(text: str, old: str, new: str, label: str) -> str:
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected exactly one match, found {count}")
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


checker_path = Path("selfhost/mvp/src/checker.virune")
checker = checker_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    '''\tlet qualifiedVariantValue = qualifiedVariantType(node.text)
\tif match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(_) => true, None => false } {
\t\tlet valueType = match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\t\treturn Ok(checkedVariant(node, qualifiedVariantName(node.text), valueType, [], expressions))
\t}
\tlet segments = qualifiedSegments(node.text)
\tif List.length(segments) <= 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t}
''',
    '''\tif !String.contains(node.text, ".") {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t}
\tlet segments = qualifiedSegments(node.text)
\tlet qualifiedVariantValue = qualifiedVariantType(segments)
\tif match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(_) => true, None => false } {
\t\tlet valueType = match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\t\treturn Ok(checkedVariant(node, qualifiedVariantName(segments), valueType, [], expressions))
\t}
\tif List.length(segments) <= 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t}
''',
    "reuse qualified identifier segments",
)

list_helpers = '''fn checkListIsEmptyCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "List.isEmpty expects 1 argument, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet sourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet checked = checkExpression(sourceId, context, expressions)?
\tif match listElementType(checked.valueType) { Some(_) => false, None => true } {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2021", "List.isEmpty requires a List, received " + typeName(checked.valueType), node.span))
\t}
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.BoolType, [checked.expressionId], checked.expressions))
}

fn checkListLastCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "List.last expects 1 argument, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet sourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet checked = checkExpression(sourceId, context, expressions)?
\tlet elementValue = listElementType(checked.valueType)
\tif match elementValue { Some(_) => false, None => true } {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2021", "List.last requires a List, received " + typeName(checked.valueType), node.span))
\t}
\tlet elementType = match elementValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\tlet resultValue = optionalType(elementType)
\tlet resultType = match resultValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\tif resultType == MvpType.ErrorType {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2021", "List.last cannot represent an Optional result for " + typeName(elementType), node.span))
\t}
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, resultType, [checked.expressionId], checked.expressions))
}

'''
checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    "fn checkStringLengthCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {",
    list_helpers + "fn checkStringLengthCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {",
    "insert remaining List builtin checkers",
)

string_helpers = '''fn checkStringContainsCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 2 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "String.contains expects 2 arguments, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet valueSourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet searchSourceId = childAt(node, 1)?
\tlet checkedValue = checkExpectedExpression(valueSourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, expressions)?
\tlet checkedSearch = checkExpectedExpression(searchSourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, checkedValue.expressions)?
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.BoolType, [checkedValue.expressionId, checkedSearch.expressionId], checkedSearch.expressions))
}

fn checkStringStartsWithCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 2 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "String.startsWith expects 2 arguments, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet valueSourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet prefixSourceId = childAt(node, 1)?
\tlet checkedValue = checkExpectedExpression(valueSourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, expressions)?
\tlet checkedPrefix = checkExpectedExpression(prefixSourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, checkedValue.expressions)?
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.BoolType, [checkedValue.expressionId, checkedPrefix.expressionId], checkedPrefix.expressions))
}

fn checkStringJoinCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 2 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "String.join expects 2 arguments, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet valuesSourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet separatorSourceId = childAt(node, 1)?
\tlet valuesType = MvpType.ListType(MvpListElementType.StringElement)
\tlet checkedValues = checkExpectedExpression(valuesSourceId, valuesType, context, expressions)?
\tlet checkedSeparator = checkExpectedExpression(separatorSourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, checkedValues.expressions)?
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.StringType, [checkedValues.expressionId, checkedSeparator.expressionId], checkedSeparator.expressions))
}

fn checkDebugFormatCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "Debug.format expects 1 argument, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet sourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet checked = checkExpression(sourceId, context, expressions)?
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.StringType, [checked.expressionId], checked.expressions))
}

fn checkPanicCall(node: MvpExpression, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tif List.length(node.children) != 1 {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "panic expects 1 argument, received " + Debug.format(List.length(node.children)), node.span))
\t}
\tlet sourceId = childAt(node, 0)?
\tlet checked = checkExpectedExpression(sourceId, MvpType.StringType, context, expressions)?
\treturn Ok(checkedBuiltinCall(node, MvpType.ErrorType, [checked.expressionId], checked.expressions))
}

'''
checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    "fn qualifiedVariantType(value: String) -> MvpType? {",
    string_helpers + "fn qualifiedVariantType(segments: List<String>) -> MvpType? {",
    "insert remaining String, Debug, and panic builtin checkers",
)
checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    '''fn qualifiedVariantType(segments: List<String>) -> MvpType? {
\tlet segments = qualifiedSegments(value)
\tif List.length(segments) != 2 {
\t\treturn None
\t}
\tlet base = match List.get(segments, 0) { Some(name) => name, None => "" }
\tif base != "FrontendTokenKind" && base != "MvpTokenKind" && base != "MvpType" && base != "MvpListElementType" && base != "MvpOptionalElementType" {
\t\treturn None
\t}
\treturn Some(MvpType.NamedType(base))
}

fn qualifiedVariantName(value: String) -> String {
\tlet segments = qualifiedSegments(value)
\treturn match List.get(segments, 1) {
\t\tSome(name) => name
\t\tNone => ""
\t}
}

fn checkQualifiedVariantCall(node: MvpExpression, valueType: MvpType, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tlet variantName = qualifiedVariantName(node.text)
''',
    '''fn qualifiedVariantType(segments: List<String>) -> MvpType? {
\tif List.length(segments) != 2 {
\t\treturn None
\t}
\tlet base = match List.get(segments, 0) { Some(name) => name, None => "" }
\tif base != "FrontendCommentKind" && base != "FrontendTokenKind" && base != "MvpTokenKind" && base != "MvpType" && base != "MvpListElementType" && base != "MvpOptionalElementType" {
\t\treturn None
\t}
\treturn Some(MvpType.NamedType(base))
}

fn qualifiedVariantName(segments: List<String>) -> String {
\treturn match List.get(segments, 1) {
\t\tSome(name) => name
\t\tNone => ""
\t}
}

fn checkQualifiedVariantCall(node: MvpExpression, segments: List<String>, valueType: MvpType, context: CheckContext, expressions: List<MvpHirExpression>) -> Result<CheckedExpression, MvpDiagnostic> {
\tlet variantName = qualifiedVariantName(segments)
''',
    "reuse qualified call segments and allow FrontendCommentKind",
)

checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    '''\tif node.text == "List.length" {
\t\treturn checkListLengthCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "String.length" {
''',
    '''\tif node.text == "List.length" {
\t\treturn checkListLengthCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "List.isEmpty" {
\t\treturn checkListIsEmptyCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "List.last" {
\t\treturn checkListLastCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "String.length" {
''',
    "dispatch remaining List builtins",
)
checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    '''\tif node.text == "String.slice" {
\t\treturn checkStringSliceCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "Json.parse" {
''',
    '''\tif node.text == "String.slice" {
\t\treturn checkStringSliceCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "String.contains" {
\t\treturn checkStringContainsCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "String.startsWith" {
\t\treturn checkStringStartsWithCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "String.join" {
\t\treturn checkStringJoinCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "Debug.format" {
\t\treturn checkDebugFormatCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "panic" {
\t\treturn checkPanicCall(node, context, expressions)
\t}
\tif node.text == "Json.parse" {
''',
    "dispatch remaining String, Debug, and panic builtins",
)
checker = replace_once(
    checker,
    '''\tif constructorName == "None" {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "None is a value and does not accept arguments", node.span))
\t}
\tlet qualifiedVariantValue = qualifiedVariantType(node.text)
\tif match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(_) => true, None => false } {
\t\tlet valueType = match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\t\treturn checkQualifiedVariantCall(node, valueType, context, expressions)
\t}
\treturn match findSignature(context.signatures, node.text) {
\t\tSome(value) => checkKnownCall(node, value, context, expressions)
\t\tNone => Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t}
''',
    '''\tif constructorName == "None" {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L2012", "None is a value and does not accept arguments", node.span))
\t}
\tlet directSignature = findSignature(context.signatures, node.text)
\tif match directSignature { Some(_) => true, None => false } {
\t\treturn match directSignature {
\t\t\tSome(value) => checkKnownCall(node, value, context, expressions)
\t\t\tNone => Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t\t}
\t}
\tif !String.contains(node.text, ".") {
\t\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
\t}
\tlet segments = qualifiedSegments(node.text)
\tlet qualifiedVariantValue = qualifiedVariantType(segments)
\tif match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(_) => true, None => false } {
\t\tlet valueType = match qualifiedVariantValue { Some(value) => value, None => MvpType.ErrorType }
\t\treturn checkQualifiedVariantCall(node, segments, valueType, context, expressions)
\t}
\treturn Err(errorDiagnostic("L1010", "Unknown name " + node.text, node.span))
''',
    "resolve signatures before qualified variant parsing",
)

checker_path.write_text(checker, encoding="utf-8")

focused_path = Path("packages/compiler/test/selfhost-qualified-builtins-variants.test.ts")
focused = focused_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
focused = replace_once(
    focused,
    "\t\t\t\t\t'pub fn functionCount(moduleValue: MvpModule) -> Int {',",
    """\t\t\t\t\t'pub fn remainingBuiltins(value: String, values: List<String>) -> Bool {',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\tlet joined = String.join(values, \",\")',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\tlet tail = List.last(values)',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\tlet formatted = Debug.format(List.length(values))',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\treturn List.isEmpty(values) || String.contains(joined, value) || String.startsWith(joined, value) || match tail { Some(item) => String.contains(formatted, item), None => false }',
\t\t\t\t\t'}',
\t\t\t\t\t'',
\t\t\t\t\t'pub fn commentKind() -> FrontendCommentKind {',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\treturn FrontendCommentKind.Ordinary',
\t\t\t\t\t'}',
\t\t\t\t\t'',
\t\t\t\t\t'pub fn impossible() -> Int {',
\t\t\t\t\t'\\treturn panic(\"boom\")',
\t\t\t\t\t'}',
\t\t\t\t\t'',
\t\t\t\t\t'pub fn functionCount(moduleValue: MvpModule) -> Int {',""",
    "extend focused builtin and enum coverage",
)
focused_path.write_text(focused, encoding="utf-8")

inventory_path = Path("packages/compiler/test/selfhost-full-language-inventory.test.ts")
inventory_test = inventory_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
inventory_test = replace_once(
    inventory_test,
    "{ timeout: 900_000 }",
    "{ timeout: 1_200_000 }",
    "raise measured inventory timeout",
)
inventory_path.write_text(inventory_test, encoding="utf-8")
